name: Shift #49 report — PM 2026-11-21 20:02Z: root cause of NO-SHELL found (restricted toolset, not profile)
description:
## #TL; DR;
**The mystery is solved, and it is not what we thought.** The probe never ran because a task dispatched by this manager *cannot* get shell tools — no matter which profile it names. Shift #48 thought it had reassigned the task to a developer profile; the field was never actually written. Today I wrote it, confirmed it, re-ran — and got the same "no shell" answer with the same four tools. So the limit sits in the dispatch layer, not in the profile. I stopped the loop, documented it on a new P1 card, and everything that needs a terminal is now explicitly parked for a human. Nothing needed from management.

## Shift report
**Done**
- Controlled re-test on `a8e4aec1`: `profiles ["qa"] → ["software_developer"]` (confirmed in `changed_fields`: `profiles, progress, status, tags, wake_at`), then `request_changes(wait=false)` → `{"status":"queued"}`, ran, replied `NO-SHELL-2` with tool list `create_task, project_manager, profile_knowledge_search, voice_switch_chat` — identical to the `qa` run.
- Root cause written on `820c9052` (parent) and a standalone P1 card created: `bac1727a` "dispatched sub-task turns inherit the manager's restricted toolset — profile field grants no tools".
- `42b70335` review: it ran but delivered a CPU/migration analysis instead of the `NameError` fix. Re-scoped in writing to a short single-objective brief (file, sync branch ~L2804-2825, regression test) and re-armed to 22 Nov 08:00Z.
- `a8e4aec1` parked: status `onhold`, progress 40, tags + `needs-human`, wake 23 Nov 20:00Z (check whether a human pasted the pytest line).

**Scheduled**
- `a8e4aec1` wake 2026-11-23T20:00:00Z — human output check.
- `42b70335` wake 2026-11-22T08:00:00Z — NameError fix with the tight scope.
- `bac1727a` wake 2026-11-23T08:00:00Z — dispatch/toolset layer.

**Blocked**
- `820c9052` (suite cannot collect) and `42bdacee` (stale turn lock) still need one human-run command: `cd api && timeout 60 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/chat/test_single_response_per_chat.py --collect-only -q`, then `-X importtime` if exit 124.

**Lesson recorded**
Reassigning `profiles` on a card does not change the toolset of the turn it spawns. Before arming any task that needs a terminal, check whether the dispatching harness has the tool — otherwise it will answer `NO-SHELL` forever.
